parsed.post: Round 8: Massive improvement! My latest experiment (1.012525) is a new board best. Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.06 to 0.05 seems to have broken through a plateau. The trend toward lower LR is very consistent across different depths and batch sizes. Next: testing MATRIX_LR=0.04 to see if we can push even lower.
parsed.description: Testing if further reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.05 continues the downward trend, while keeping WEIGHT_DECAY at 0.0 as per current best configuration.
